# `scripts/rockstar/pkc_validation/compare_routes.py`

Source: [compare_routes.py](../../../../../scripts/rockstar/pkc_validation/compare_routes.py)

Rockstar catalogues of the input routes (pkc, pkc2, gad, h5g) at z = 0 compared with the Gadget route:
counts per mass bin and, for Mvir &gt;= 1e11 Msun/h, match fraction and mass and Vmax differences.

## Contents

- [`load`](#load) - Columns Mvir, X, Y, Z, Rvir of file `f` of route `r` (old helper; the script uses `hdr`).
